summary: Static-analysis review of JMA sticker book, achievements, ranks, and songs. All checks PASSED: (a) all 16 song ids in songs.js have matching `song_${id}` stickers in stickers.js, (b) all 33 static earnSticker() call sites reference existing sticker ids, plus 1 dynamic template `lesson_${num}` which resolves to lesson_1..lesson_7 (all present), (c) all 54 icon PNG paths across stickers/achievements/ranks resolve to real files under /app/frontend/public/, (d) no user-facing display strings reference the retired names 'Boom Garden', 'Stew's Rhythm Academy', or 'Rhythm Academy' (only internal filenames, route paths, and code-comments retain them, which is acceptable), (e) meta-progression standards are correctly implemented: useRank.js derives rank from ACHIEVEMENT stickers only (via ALL_ACHIEVEMENT_IDS filter), ranks.js Maestro requires 3 domains at master tier, earnAchievement enforces cadet->pro->master prerequisite within domain, and earnAchievementUpTo iterates the ordered ladder. The sticker-song alignment fix applied by the main agent is verified correct.
critical_code_review_comments: The stickers.js comment on line ~85 references 'Feb 30' as a fix date — cosmetic nit; not a real date. Consider replacing with an actual date or removing the parenthetical.

useLessonsProgress.js uses dynamic template `earnSticker(`lesson_${num}`)` — verified lesson_1..lesson_7 all exist in stickers.js. If lessons.js ever adds a lesson 8 without a matching sticker, that call becomes a silent no-op. Consider a defensive assert or auto-generating lesson stickers from lessons.js.

GameHeader title on BoomGardenPage.js line 1006 & 1133 correctly reads 'Who’s Got the Rhythm' — but the internal filename BoomGardenPage.js and route `/boom-garden` (per the review request) intentionally retain the old identifier. This is acceptable but a future rename pass could unify naming for maintainability.

Ranks ladder in ranks.js has 7 tiers and reasonable requirements. Note there's no explicit requirement enforcing that Performer (3 pro badges) implies all 3 domains have Cadet — that's IMPLICITLY guaranteed by the intra-domain Cadet→Pro prereq in earnAchievement(). Correctness confirmed by construction.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static-only review of frontend data files. The reusable script /app/test_reports/static_check.py validates: song→sticker mapping, earnSticker() call-site validity, PNG icon path resolution, retired-name artifacts in user-facing strings, and meta-progression structural checks. Run `python3 /app/test_reports/static_check.py` on future data changes; exit code 0 = clean.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found in this review iteration. The song-sticker misalignment described in the original request has been correctly fixed by the main agent: stickers.js now has exactly the 16 song stickers matching songs.js ids (jma_play_one_skip_one, jma_magic_in_music, jma_brand_new_friend, jma_faster_as_we_go, jma_goody_bag, jma_play_one_drums, jma_goody_bag_drums, jam_drums_pocket, jam_drums_boogie, ode_to_joy, when_saints, amazing_grace, jelly_groove, ocean_wave, bell_bounce, funky_fish).
